faq.question: Do you offer both online and offline classes?
faq.answer: Yes! Reboot Code Academy provides both offline classroom-based training at our Bhimavaram campus and highly interactive live online classes with industry expert trainers.

faq.question: Is there a placement assistance program?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We offer 100% placement assistance, which includes resume building, mock interviews, LinkedIn profiling, and organizing direct interviews with our hiring partner MNCs.

faq.question: Are there any prerequisites to join the Full Stack courses?
faq.answer: No prior coding experience is required! Our courses start from absolute basics (HTML/CSS, core logic) and gradually advance to enterprise development.

faq.question: Do we get hands-on practical experience?
faq.answer: Yes, all our programs are project-based. For example, in Java/Python Full Stack, you will build and deploy at least 2 complete live projects.

faq.question: Where is the academy located?
faq.answer: Our physical campus is located in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh. It is equipped with advanced infrastructure, high-speed internet, and dedicated lab spaces.
